claims.text: SAMPLE. AI-credited flaws reach CISA's exploited list no more often than other flaws: most AI-found bugs are low-impact.
SAMPLE. By the end of 2028, AI-powered malware is used in an attack on UK critical national infrastructure, as the UK government or the NCSC publicly confirms.

entries.summary: SAMPLE. First reading: the base-rate ratio has no value yet, because no AI-credited flaw since 2025 has reached CISA's list.
The NCSC's annual review says attackers used AI to speed up reconnaissance against UK organisations, but reports no confirmed AI-powered malware in an attack on critical infrastructure.
entries.quote: We have not yet seen AI-powered malware used in an attack on UK critical national infrastructure.
